-- CIRCULARITY TEST. Over Spec k (k a field), the space is a single point,
-- so the only nonempty open is ⊤, i.e. any cover with ⨆ U i = ⊤ must have

    (hU : ⨆ i, U i = ⊤) : ∃ i, U i = ⊤ := by
  haveI : Subsingleton (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) :=
    inferInstanceAs (Subsingleton (PrimeSpectrum k))
  haveI : Nonempty (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) :=
    inferInstanceAs (Nonempty (PrimeSpectrum k))
  obtain ⟨x⟩ := ‹Nonempty (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))›

  rw [← hU] at hx

  refine ⟨i, ?_⟩
  ext y
  simp only [TopologicalSpace.Opens.coe_top, Set.mem_univ, iff_true]
  rwa [Subsingleton.elim y x]

import Mathlib
open CategoryTheory AlgebraicGeometry

-- General fact: for an equivalence e : C ≌ D and F : Dᵒᵖ ⥤ Type w,
-- (e.functor.op ⋙ F).RepresentableBy Y  →  F.RepresentableBy (e.functor.obj Y).
noncomputable def transportRep {C D : Type*} [Category C] [Category D]
    (e : C ≌ D) {F : Dᵒᵖ ⥤ Type 1} {Y : C}
    (R : (e.functor.op ⋙ F).RepresentableBy Y) :
    F.RepresentableBy (e.functor.obj Y) where
  homEquiv {T} := (e.symm.toAdjunction.homEquiv T Y).trans R.homEquiv
  homEquiv_comp {T T'} f g := by
    dsimp
    rw [← R.homEquiv_comp (e.inverse.map f) (e.symm.toAdjunction.homEquiv T' Y g)]
    congr 1
    simp [Equivalence.toAdjunction, Adjunction.homEquiv]

-- Applied at S: the ⊤ chart hypothesis IS the conclusion.

    (h : ∃ Y : Over (⊤ : S.Opens).toScheme,
      Nonempty (((Over.map (⊤ : S.Opens).ι).op ⋙ F).RepresentableBy Y)) :
    ∃ Y : Over S, Nonempty (F.RepresentableBy Y) := by
  haveI : IsIso (⊤ : S.Opens).ι := (Scheme.topIso S).isIso_hom
  obtain ⟨Y, ⟨R⟩⟩ := h
  exact ⟨(Over.map (⊤ : S.Opens).ι).obj Y,
    ⟨transportRep (Over.map (⊤ : S.Opens).ι).asEquivalence R⟩⟩
